name: Hybrid GDN + SWA
tagline: Alternating gated delta blocks and sliding-window attention blocks.
description: A 22-layer, 1.330B-parameter hybrid alternating GDN and sliding-window attention (SWA) eleven times: 11 GDN layers at one-based odd layers and 11 SWA layers at even layers. The 1:1 layout follows the Gated DeltaNet H1 recipe (lit_gpt gated_delta_per_layer=2) with a registered 2048-token window, while the mixers and shared shell retain this repository's GDN and native attention adaptations. At the 2048-token training context, the 2048-key window (left window 2047 plus the current token) covers every causal key, so SWA layers compute full causal attention and this model evaluates a 1:1 GDN/global-attention alternation at 2K context. Width is 1536, with 12 heads of dimension 128, FFN width 6528, vocabulary 32768, and a 2048-token context. Blocks have independent weights; this is not a recursive or weight-tied model.
paperTitle: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
mechanism: Sliding-window causal MHA (window 2048: left window 2047 plus the current token) at one-based even layers 2, 4, ..., 22, with 12 query and 12 KV heads; GDN at one-based odd layers 1, 3, ..., 21. At sequence length 2048, the window reaches the first token from every query, equivalent to full causal MHA.

GDN uses input-dependent scalar decay per head, delta-rule correction, length-4 causal convolutions, L2-normalized q/k, sigmoid beta, and gated normalized output. The fla_chunk64 backend uses FLA's equivalent chunked KDA kernel with a broadcast per-head gate.

The native shell retains untied embeddings, ReLU-squared FFNs, RMSNorm, smear, backout, and learned residual/x0 coefficients. Native QK normalization and RoPE apply to SWA layers; the alternating even-layer VE rule places VE on all 11 SWA layers and on no GDN layer.
Packed rows use native BOS best-fit packing. GDN state resets at each row boundary, not at every BOS; causal attention may cross document boundaries inside a row.

Single-stage, from-scratch BF16 training uses the shared Muon+AdamW protocol: seed 42, 49.152B input tokens, 1,048,576 tokens per update, and 46,875 updates. CORE evaluates all 22 tasks at steps 8000, 16000, 24000, 32000, 40000, and 46875; periodic validation and independent final BPB remain separate.
limitations: A repository adaptation of the Gated DeltaNet H1 1:1 GDN + SWA layout. Because the registered 2048-key sliding window equals the 2048-token training context, the window never truncates keys during 2K training or evaluation, making this run a 1:1 GDN/full-attention comparison rather than a sub-context local-window test. Unlike the official lit_gpt SWA, the attention layers retain native QK normalization and VE. The completed run used FLA for GDN and deterministic SDPA with FlashAttention disabled for SWA; do not infer FlashAttention throughput from this result. Theoretical training FLOPs include forward, backward, and optimizer work, not measured hardware speed. Single-seed 2K-context results do not establish statistical superiority, long-context quality, or inference memory/speed gains. BPB, CORE and per-run provenance belong in the associated run record; this card alone does not establish a matched run or an accepted full-Dense comparison. The recorded software source hashes reflect a launch-environment patch on top of the frozen training source while model and protocol hashes and cost proofs are identical; the patch diff, a separate 512-update pilot, and distributed fresh-process resume acceptance on the training cluster have not been evidenced. The submitted run completed; final acceptance remains subject to maintainer review.
